gloss_en: Where do I learn how IFC alignment and geometry/instances relate, to place rail elements along an alignment for a thesis?
title_original: Understanding IFC Alignment and Rail - Beginners guide
question_paraphrase: supporting a colleague's master thesis on placing railway elements programmatically along an alignment; where to learn the relation between geometry and instances and how to read or create an IfcAlignment
context_given: proprietary design software exports badly to IFC
phrasing_notes: polite, offers a 30 minute call, academic framing; returned in 2024 asking again how to build 3D axis from horizontal and vertical alignment
answer_summary: Read the IFC4.3 Alignment Layout and Product Linear Placement concept pages; use IfcRelPositions with placements relative to the alignment; use 4.3 not the withdrawn 4.2; later pointed to a community alignment geometry implementation guide.

gloss_en: I exported an alignment from ProVI as IFC 4x1; Civil 3D imports without error but shows nothing, even after zoom extents.
title_original: IFC 4x1 file containing alignment is not opening in Civil 3D
question_paraphrase: highway project, alignment exported from ProVI as IFC4x1, Civil 3D 2022 import finishes but nothing on screen; ground and corridor surfaces via IFC2x3 had worked
phrasing_notes: states what worked (IFC2x3 surfaces) vs what fails; asks if anyone ever did this transfer
answer_summary: IFC 4.1 was withdrawn and never certified, so exports are unreliable; ask the vendor to export IFC4.3.

gloss_en: StartDistAlong existed in 4.3 RC2 for start chainage but is gone in 4.3.2.0; where do I set the start of a horizontal alignment now?
title_original: StartDistAlong in IfcAlignmentHorizontal 4.3. rc2
question_paraphrase: attribute StartDistAlong (start chainage) missing in final 4.3.2.0; need curvilinear abscissa not Cartesian StartPoint
phrasing_notes: precise schema terms, says start chainage is critical for his work
answer_summary: Use an IfcReferent with PredefinedType STATION and Pset_Stationing, nested in the IfcAlignment and positioned with IfcRelPositions on a linear placement; docs need clearer examples.

gloss_en: US roads use stations and offsets along an alignment; how does the new IFC alignment handle that?
title_original: New alignment and need for stations and offsets
question_paraphrase: US road infrastructure uses station/offset; how is that handled in the RC2 alignment; later: IfcLinearPlacement with StartDistAlong=500 put an object at 1500 ft instead of station 15+00
phrasing_notes: engineer's shorthand 'station 15+00', tests in a viewer and reports exact numbers
answer_summary: DistanceAlong is purely geometric; stationing is semantic on IfcReferent (STATION) plus Pset_Stationing; for station 15+00 with 5+00 start the distance along is 1000.

gloss_en: How can German rail alignment data (GNEDIT, VERM.ESN) be imported into IFC when height data lives on separate centerlines?
title_original: How is it possible to import german/rail Ver.esn / or GNEDIT in IFC?
question_paraphrase: German rail uses a station line without heights plus extra centerlines carrying height and slope referencing its chainage; cannot see how to represent this in IFC
phrasing_notes: names national formats and file extensions, worried planners cannot combine DB GIS with IFC
answer_summary: Contact German industry reps; review the IFC Rail candidate standard (IFC4.3) and the IFC Rail team.

phrasing_notes: short, direct question; thread then turns to waterfall vs agile standardization
answer_summary: The view is described in the core 4.3 docs and concept templates; official MVD status pending, but implementers can start using it.
